deterministic_automation.label: Deterministic automation or conventional software
limitations: Use AI only when language understanding, generation, uncertain reasoning, or adaptive orchestration adds material value.

m365_copilot.label: Microsoft 365 Copilot
limitations: Best suited to Microsoft 365 interaction surfaces and licensed capabilities.
Custom workflow and application requirements may require Copilot Studio or pro-code extensions.

copilot_studio.label: Microsoft Copilot Studio
limitations: Power Platform governance, connector, environment, and capacity requirements need validation.
Verify the current status of event-triggered or autonomous capabilities.

m365_agents_sdk.label: Microsoft 365 Agents SDK
limitations: Requires pro-code delivery and lifecycle ownership.
Best fit when Microsoft 365 and Teams are primary channels.

agent_framework_agui.label: Microsoft Agent Framework with AG-UI
limitations: Requires a custom application experience and pro-code operational ownership.
Verify current protocol and feature lifecycle status before production use.

microsoft_foundry.label: Microsoft Foundry
limitations: Requires Azure architecture, identity, networking, observability, evaluation, and operational ownership.
Model, region, quota, and feature availability must be verified.

foundry_agent_service.label: Microsoft Foundry Agent Service
limitations: Hosted and prompt agent constraints differ; select the runtime only after validating required code and tool control.
Private networking and managed identity requirements must be designed with the workload.

logic_apps.label: Azure Logic Apps agentic workflows
limitations: Use for integration-led workflows rather than treating it as a general-purpose agent SDK.
Verify current agentic workflow lifecycle status.

foundry_windows.label: Microsoft Foundry on Windows
limitations: Validate device, local model, operating-system, and fleet-management constraints.

microsoft_fabric.label: Microsoft Fabric
limitations: Best fit for analytics-centric data products and governed Fabric estates.
Validate capacity, workspace governance, and data residency.

grounding.none: No retrieval layer is required for the stated workload.
grounding.m365: Use Microsoft Graph-grounded capabilities or Graph connectors where supported.
grounding.documents: Use Foundry IQ or Azure AI Search with citations and injection-resistant retrieval instructions.
grounding.structured: Choose a vector-capable data store that fits the existing system of record; do not introduce a new database only for fashion.
grounding.analytics: Use Microsoft Fabric when governed analytics data and semantic models are central to the workload.

deploymentTargets.multi_channel: Multiple channels through an appropriate SDK or channel adapter
